items.summary: Unify media source-of-truth so that the same committed media set (hero background, 43 image slots, 6 video slots, and background song) is what renders in Draft, Preview, and Published modes (Draft = Preview = Published). After a successful Media Manager Submit, the app must render from the committed set and must not show any older placeholders or regenerated/static assets for those slots.

Add a strict "uploaded-only" rendering rule for all modes: for hero background, each image slot, each video slot, and the background song, render the user’s committed uploaded media if present; if not present, render an explicit empty state (no placeholder assets, no default packaged media, no regeneration). This rule must apply consistently in Draft, Preview, and Published.

Remove/disable any media lazy-loading or visibility gating that can cause committed uploaded media to appear missing (e.g., `loading="lazy"` on committed images, deferred video source assignment that never triggers, conditional rendering that hides media until interaction). Committed uploaded media must be eagerly attached to the DOM and begin loading immediately on initial render across Draft, Preview, and Published.

Make backend-published media retrieval and frontend decoding/rendering deterministic and identical across Preview and Published builds: the frontend must always interpret the Motoko `getPublishedMedia()` response consistently (including optionals/tuples and slot indexing), producing stable, renderable URLs for every committed slot and never silently dropping media due to decode/mapping issues.

Add one structured, English-only diagnostic console log on app start and one on every successful Submit that confirms the exact committed media state used for rendering across modes (counts for hero/images/videos/song, plus image order + transform counts). This diagnostics output must be identical in shape across Draft, Preview, and Published to aid verification that Draft = Preview = Published.
